description: A highly chaotic, French-flavored absurd comedy game UI. The aesthetic combines neo-brutalist web design, risograph print textures, and comic-book pop art. No smooth gradients, no soft shadows. Everything is loud, raw, and tactile.

heading_styles.h1: text-6xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-9xl tracking-tighter uppercase font-heading text-[#0A0A0A] drop-shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#FF3B30]
heading_styles.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight uppercase font-heading text-[#0A0A0A]

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-4, p-6, p-8. Elements should feel chunky.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-xl (mix sharp brutalism with comic soft shapes)

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white border-4 border-[#0A0A0A] font-heading uppercase text-3xl px-8 py-4 shadow-[8px_8px_0px_#0A0A0A] hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A] hover:translate-x-[4px] hover:translate-y-[4px] transition-all duration-100
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-[#0A0A0A] border-4 border-[#0A0A0A] font-heading uppercase text-2xl px-6 py-3 shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#0A0A0A] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#0A0A0A] hover:translate-x-[4px] hover:translate-y-[4px] transition-all duration-100

components.cards: bg-surface border-4 border-[#0A0A0A] p-6 shadow-[8px_8px_0px_#0A0A0A] relative overflow-hidden
components.hud: fixed top-0 w-full p-4 flex justify-between items-center pointer-events-none z-50
components.health_bar: h-8 border-4 border-[#0A0A0A] bg-white relative overflow-hidden
components.charge_bar: h-12 border-4 border-[#0A0A0A] bg-white rounded-full overflow-hidden w-full max-w-md mx-auto relative

motion_and_juice.transitions: Use fast, snappy transitions. No slow easing. 75ms or 150ms max.
motion_and_juice.particles: Burst of comic action stars and 'BAM!' or 'PAF!' text elements emerging on impact using absolute positioning or framer-motion

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the heavy custom UI. Avoid Shadcn for the main game arena as it requires high-customization brutalist designs. Use Shadcn only for generic settings modals or forms.
Implement Web Audio API for synthetic sound effects (slap charge, hit, fail, cheers).
Use Framer Motion to handle the charge-and-release mechanic, combo multipliers popping up, and the screen shake.
Extend tailwind.config.js with custom keyframes for 'shake' (rapid pixel translations), 'wobble', and 'float'. Use 'Bangers' and 'Space Mono' for fonts.
Add a halftone dot overlay using mix-blend-multiply or opacity masks on backgrounds to enforce the risograph aesthetic. Keep border radius blocky or completely sharp.
Use React canvas or simple absolute positioned DOM elements for the random chaos items falling from the top.
Test IDs are MANDATORY on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='slap-button', data-testid='charge-meter').
Keep files as .js or .jsx, NO TypeScript.
Use pure HTML Canvas or framer-motion particles for the heavy juice impacts ('PAF!', 'BING!', stars, screen flashes).
